about_the_game:
Get ready to travel through dangerous levels where countless threats await you! Each level is a maze of paths, and you'll have to move carefully, step by step, dodging traps and solving puzzles.: Fight enemies face to face or avoid them. What is your main goal? Complete each level without loss.

In the fight for survival, weapons are your key ally. Find it and use it wisely, but remember: any weapon has limited durability. Keep an eye on the condition of your equipment — a worn-out blade can break in the midst of a battle. Shields are also vital for protection, fending off enemy attacks. Look for power-ups to restore the strength of shields and weapons, because without them, your defense can fail at a critical moment.

The enemies will chase you relentlessly, and everyone has their own abilities and tactics. While they're hunting you, remember: the best strategy is cunning and quick decisions. Skillful maneuvers will help you outplay even the strongest opponents. If a collision can be avoided, consider running away. Sometimes that's what will save your life.

Get ready for an exciting challenge where every step can be your last. Be careful, act wisely, and you may be able to survive!
